raw.title: Repair, re-insulation and re-capping of 103.5 MW, 11kV Generator Stator winding Bottom overhang portion of Unit No.09 at Sharavathy Generating Station, Jog falls
raw.description: Dismantling and removal of the existing defective insulating caps from 100 Nos. of stator winding bottom overhang brazed joints of Unit No. 09. Thorough cleaning and preparation of the conductor brazing joints and surrounding surfaces for insulation restoration. Carrying out necessary repair, re-insulation and application of suitable insulating resin as per approved technical specifications.
